page.layout: One column of index entries, with a marginal note at the right beside the entry "Aulicorum splendida miseria". Running head at the top. Margin mark at the left beside the same entry. No page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Personas non respiciendo: nec indulgendo affectibus, irae nimirum, amori, gratiae, metui.
Prudenti judici in judicando quae sint attendenda?
Causae veritas prius sedulo inquirenda, quam sententia feratur:
In eruenda veritate non raro naturalis observanda σοφίη[?]:
Utrum judicibus de re judicanda sibi invicem contradicere liceat?
ɪɟ.[?]Aulicorum splendida miseria. Hic attendendiDe aulicis in genere Maris aulici
Venti: Favor, Invidia, Cupiditas, Ambitio, Luxus, Consuetudo prava, Egestas.

page.notes: The left-margin mark before "Aulicorum splendida miseria" is doubtful (read as ɪɟ.). The Greek word after "observanda" is doubtful; it is read as σοφίη. The right-margin note "De aulicis in genere" is printed across two lines and is kept as one note.
